s.zh: 法术特效
施放 DND 法术与职业能力时显示特效
s.en: Show effects when casting DND spells and class abilities

s.zh: 预热时脚下出现法阵，施放时有光球飞向目标、落点按元素（火、冰、雷、死灵、神圣、治疗、暗影、毒、血、自然、心灵、力场、近战等）爆发；范围法术的光环按半径放大。只是视觉效果，不影响数值。
s.en: A circle appears underfoot during warmup, a light orb flies to the target on casting, and the impact bursts by element (fire, ice, lightning, necrotic, holy, healing, shadow, poison, blood, nature, psychic, force, melee, etc.); area spells' auras scale with their radius. Purely visual; doesn't affect numbers.
